label: There is a finite universally accessible model with an actual source-to-effect power-transmission…
paraphrase: There is a finite universally accessible model with an actual source-to-effect power-transmission edge and a non-intrinsically-powered effect, while the intrinsically powered source exists contingently and another being directly supports its existence. There is another coherent model with the same actual transmission and non-intrinsic effect, in which the source exists in every accessible world without a recorded external supporter yet has a proper component. Thus original power in one selected respect by itself does not logically entail underived existence, necessity, or lacking a proper component (one kind of composition that DEF-SIMPLE excludes; the model's PowerExistenceBoundary.Composite is not the Case vocabulary's Composite). The model does not equate actual transmission, bare capacity, and act as metaphysical actuality.
